page.layout: One text column on the right, with marginal notes in the left margin beside the entries. Running head and page number at the top. Catchword at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: SmirisSmiris lapis est durus, quo vitrum finditur. Scal. exerc.135.
PyritesPyrites vulgo Marcasita est lapis, qui chalybe percussus scintillas ignis edit.De hoc Scal. exerc, 104. sect. 21.
Solidi lapides, qui nitet, sunt marmora.
MarmorMarmor est lapis solidus, nitidus & eximius, maculis & coloribus variis commendatus.
Pro colorum autem & macularum varietate, multae ejus traduntur species[?], sed praecipuae sunt, Alabastrites, Ophites, & Porphyrites.
Alaba-stritesAlabastrites est marmor perspicuum, candidum, e quo pyrides pro odoratis unguentis fiunt.
OphitesOphites est marmor maculis serpen-tum simile.
Porphy-ritesPorphyrites est marmor rubeis & quasi candidis maculis distinctum: seu potius rubeum, cum maculis internitentibus.
Degem-misPretiosi lapides ex subtiliore & tenui-ore materia, singulari caeli influxu con-gelascunt, & dicuntur Gemmae.
Alia tamen loca pro diversitate radiorum solarium, pretiosiores aliis producunt lapides.

page.notes: The page-end catchword "Hinc" is at the lower right. The word "species" after "multae ejus traduntur" is partly unclear, so it is marked [?]. The printed "edit.De" has no space, and I kept it as printed. The "Pretiosi" in the text is italic. Marginal notes are read as they stand, with their printed hyphens.
